text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I won't hesitate! From start to finish, I'll run my own race!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH, I will bring them down!!
Even if my opponent is a god or Buddha!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"The final straight.
In this single moment—give it everything!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I will never give up!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!!

Everyone gave 200% to run a race
that only they could run.
And thenâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, even if all these stars stand side by side,
the one to rule this generation is none other than me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! My beloved people,
thank you, thank you!
Fin de siècle forever!

The winner was T.M. Opera O.
Though no longer the absolute ruler,
her position as the pioneer remained unshakable.

And so, after the race,
all four of them gathered in the underground paddock tunnel—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work, everyone.
The audience was thrilled, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There have been many great races up until now,
—but I think today's was the hottest race of all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “Indeed. A stage truly shines only when it's graced by an exceptional cast.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well, how it felt... wasn't bad, maybe.
I was able to give it everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"It means I've gotten stronger... right?
Even the weakest version of me, properly lifted up."

Each of them voiced their sense of fulfillment.
And—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um...! I've been thinking.
I don't want this excitement to just end with today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you race with us next time too?
In the year-end grand race, the 'Arima Kinen,'
with this same lineup."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure the fans are looking forward to what comes next too. That's why!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see. A rematch for the title of strongest of our generation?
That sounds fine by me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However... Top Road-san.
Care to try a slightly different
approach for the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have a proposal. An idea that only makes sense
now that you've raced this far.
choice_data_list: What kind of idea is that...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"We'll talk about that another time. Everyone
must be tired today, after all."

And so, TM Opera O's proposal
was postponed to a later date.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that, Spe-chan?
That race just now."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What do you say, after all this time...?
Why not lend your ear—and your skills—as the Supreme Commander of Japan?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Grass-chan too, right?
Not as a mentor lending a hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to try running together!
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm truly...
I'm so, so very glad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, Opera O-chan, and Doto-chan—all three of them are in my class!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Getting to spend this time together
with the four of us makes me so very happy!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I feel the same way.
Yeah, I feel the same way.

text_block_list.text: Those wonderful Umamusume. Being among them is what made Narita Top Road who she is today.

And then, the Arima Kinen awaiting them in a month.
What kind of finish line
will the four of them reach?
